> 第十八章 时空裂缝（第1页）
“轰！”火球术的爆炸，在训练场上掀扯起一大片泥土与石砾。
处于塞恩对面的低级学徒在一声惨叫过后，大声呼喊投降，并狼狈退出了战斗区域。
一条手臂在塞恩次级火球术的威能下烧焦废掉，这是那名低级学徒挑战塞恩失败后的代价。
黑魔法学院从来都没有什么点到为止一说，学徒之间动辄死伤的情况，也解释清楚了每年都有一批精神力合格的幼童来到黑魔法学院，但学院学徒总数始终提不起来的原因。
其实当塞恩上场后，很长一段时间都没有学徒上前挑战。
凶名在外的他，似乎直接锁定了前三之一。
但在这黑魔法学院，总归是有些不怕死的存在。
实力不及塞恩的他，最终以损失一条手臂为代价，更让塞恩的凶名彪悍了几分。
更让不少围观这处战斗的低级学徒们为之咋舌的是，塞恩从始至终没有拿出他那根底牌短杖，仅仅是一手纯熟的火球术运用技巧，就让他在同级中作为佼佼者。
两个月时间里，塞恩不断钻研学习导师摩西多交给他的那两本魔法笔记，自然是有其收获的。
更快的魔法释放速度、更小的魔力消耗、以及塞恩本身所具备的战斗天赋和敏锐反应能力，击败对手只是顺理成章而已。
作为魔法师来讲，有时候你比对方释放的魔法速度更快，这其实就已经决定了结果。
塞恩必须得感谢摩西多导师的魔法笔记，也得感谢菲儿师姐的私下指导。
如果没有他们，他绝对无法在两个月时间里，有此明显进步。
此时再让塞恩去咸水巨鳄的领地闯一闯，虽然仍旧会有极大危险伴随，但塞恩必定会比两个月前更加从容许多。
黑袍下的右手紧紧握着短杖，塞恩一边凭借强酸手杖恢复着精神力和魔力，一边审视着下一个可能出现的对手。
按照惯例，一名低级学徒一般连胜三场，就能获得学院奖励。
因为不是所有低级学徒都会为了那份学院奖励搭上自己的生命，塞恩去年所获得的第六名成绩，是他两胜一负后，综合排下的名次。

除了塞恩这里，训练场上其它学徒之间的战斗也已展开。
低级学徒所在区域，应该是最没“看头”的战场，因为普遍这些学徒们只会一个魔法，会两个的已经算是稀有物种。
真正吸引训练场内数百名学徒关注目光的，其实是中级学徒与高级学徒所在战场。
五颜六色的魔力光辉，让这些来到幽暗地域时间并不久的小家伙们，在感受这里沉重生存压力和危机四伏情况的同时，又不免对未来及力量抱有憧憬。
力量，才是绝大多数学徒学习魔法的源动力。
至于摩西多导师所说的“探究真理”以及“魔法的真谛”，真正理解的人少之又少。
当训练场上的战斗如火如荼进行时，看台上的三位黑魔法师无视训练场上已经出现的死伤情况，而是自顾自的聊着天。
其实主要还是其中的两位黑魔法师凑在一起闲聊，另一位拥有一头蓝色头发且具备冰冷气质的男子则很少说话。

> Chapter 18 Cracks in Time and Space (Page 1)
"Boom!" The explosion of the fireball technique kicked up a large piece of soil and gravel on the training ground.
After a scream, the low-level apprentice opposite Thain shouted for surrender and exited the battle area in embarrassment.
An arm was burnt and wasted by the power of Thain's secondary fireball. This was the price for the low-level apprentice's failure to challenge Thain.
The Black Magic Academy has never stopped talking about it. The frequent deaths and injuries among the apprentices clearly explain the reason why a group of mentally qualified children come to the Black Magic Academy every year, but the total number of apprentices in the academy has never been increased.
In fact, when Thain came on the field, no apprentice came forward to challenge him for a long time.
With his notorious reputation, he seems to be directly targeting one of the top three.
But in this black magic academy, there are some people who are not afraid of death.
Being inferior to Thane in strength, he ended up losing an arm, which made Thain's reputation even more fierce.
What made many low-level apprentices watching the battle even more astonished was that Thain never took out his short staff, his trump card. His skill in using fireball alone made him the best in his class.
For two months, Thain continued to study and study the two magic notebooks given to him by his mentor Moses, and he naturally gained something.
With faster magic release speed, smaller magic power consumption, and Thane's own fighting talent and keen reflexes, defeating his opponent is just a matter of course.
As a magician, sometimes you can release magic faster than the opponent, which actually determines the result.
Thain must thank his mentor Moses for his magic notes, and also his senior sister Fei'er for her private guidance.
Without them, he would never have made such significant progress in two months.
At this time, if Thain were to venture into the territory of the saltwater giant crocodile, although there would still be great dangers, Thain would definitely be much more calm than two months ago.
The short staff was tightly held in his right hand under the black robe. While using the acid staff to restore his mental strength and magic power, Thain was examining the next possible opponent.
According to convention, a low-level apprentice will generally receive academy rewards if he wins three games in a row.
Because not all low-level apprentices would risk their lives for the academy reward, Thain's sixth place result last year was his overall ranking after two wins and one loss.
In addition to Thain, battles between other apprentices on the training ground have also begun.
The area where low-level apprentices are located should be the least "visible" battlefield, because generally these apprentices only know one magic, and those who know two are considered a rare species.
What really attracted the attention of hundreds of apprentices in the training ground was the battlefield where the intermediate apprentices and advanced apprentices were.
The colorful magical light makes these little guys who have just arrived in the Dark Territory feel the heavy survival pressure and crisis-ridden situation here, and at the same time they can't help but have longing for the future and power.
Power is the source of motivation for most apprentices to learn magic.
As for the "search for the truth" and "the true meaning of magic" mentioned by Teacher Moshe, very few people truly understand it.
When the battle on the training ground was in full swing, the three black magicians in the stands ignored the casualties that had appeared on the training ground and chatted among themselves.
In fact, the main thing was that the two black magicians chatted together, while the other man with blue hair and a cold temperament rarely spoke.
